            with self.ui_test.execute_dialog_through_command(".uno:TextAttributes") as TextDialog:

                TSB_AUTOGROW_SIZE = TextDialog.getChild('TSB_AUTOGROW_SIZE')
                TSB_AUTOGROW_SIZE.executeAction("CLICK",tuple())
